title: spellcheck summary record (v1)
description: The terminal record of a successful spellcheck lookup: the observed correction count, the constant first page and its zero-based upstream offset (the endpoint is non-paginated, so both are always their first-page values), the exchange status, and the request identifiers the response offered. Rate-limit windows and usage stay in the JSON envelope's meta, not in JSONL records, so every line stays lean and independently parseable.
